condition.zh: 感染管制 · 植入物再處理

tagline.zh: 借來的托盤、一包濕的器械、一支沒長的指示劑
tagline.en: A loaner tray, a wet pack and an indicator that did not grow

desc.zh: 感染管制輪訓日，也是明天第一台的植入物協調人。你以為會是輕鬆的一天。
desc.en: Infection-control rotation day, and you are also the implant coordinator for tomorrow's first case. You expected an easy day.

desc.zh: 從污染區到無菌庫房，每一個包都經過你的手。你看得見別人看不見的：生物負荷、濕點、沒變色的指示劑。
desc.en: From the dirty side to the sterile store, every pack passes through your hands. You see what others miss: bioburden, damp spots, an indicator that did not change colour.

role.zh: 消毒供應中心督導（師傅）

about.zh: 二十年前是骨科刷手護理師，現在管全院的器械。口頭禪：「看不見的，才最要緊。」
about.en: An orthopaedic scrub nurse twenty years ago; now she runs every instrument in the hospital. Catchphrase: 'What you can't see matters most.'

about.zh: 清洗消毒機是他的樂器，每一輪結束他都去看濾網。口袋裡有一支 ATP 檢測棒。
about.en: The washer-disinfector is his instrument; he checks the filter after every cycle. Keeps an ATP swab in his pocket.

about.zh: 閉著眼睛也能從重量分出骨科托盤少了哪一支器械。
about.en: Can tell by weight, eyes closed, which instrument is missing from an orthopaedic tray.

about.zh: 借用托盤由他送來，永遠遲到十分鐘，永遠說「上一家醫院剛消毒過」。
about.en: Delivers the loaner trays, always ten minutes late, always saying 'the last hospital only just sterilised it'.

about.zh: 手術部位感染的每一個案子，她都畫成一條時間軸。
about.en: Draws every surgical site infection as a timeline.

about.zh: 改刀表的人。今天會打兩通電話，一通想提前，一通道歉。
about.en: The one who rewrites the theatre list. Two calls today: one to bring a case forward, one to apologise.

about.zh: 7 床一直問鋼板到了沒；夜裡量到發燒，她會先量第二次。
about.en: Bed 7 keeps asking whether the plate has arrived; when she finds a fever at night she takes it twice before calling.

role.zh: 病人・28 歲幼兒園老師

about.zh: 右橈骨遠端骨折復位後位置跑掉，明天第一台掌側鋼板。她在病房用手機查「借用器械」是什麼意思。
about.en: Her right distal radius fracture slipped after reduction; a volar plate tomorrow, first case. On the ward she is googling what 'loaner instruments' means.

plain.zh: 廠商暫借、用完就收回的器械與植入物托盤。到院一律當作未滅菌，從清洗開始全部重來。
plain.en: Instrument and implant trays lent by a company and collected again after the operation. On arrival they are treated as unsterile and reprocessed from the wash onwards.

plain.zh: 污染區到清潔區到無菌區，人與物只能往乾淨的方向走，不能回頭。
plain.en: Dirty area to clean area to sterile store: people and things move only towards clean, never back.

plain.zh: 器械上殘留的微生物與有機物。洗不乾淨，滅菌就不保證有效。
plain.en: The microbes and organic soil left on an instrument. If the wash does not remove them, sterilisation cannot be relied on.

plain.zh: 自動刷洗、沖洗、熱消毒的機器。器械要打開關節、拆到最小單位、不要疊。
plain.en: The machine that washes, rinses and thermally disinfects. Instruments go in opened, dismantled to their smallest parts and never stacked.

plain.zh: 每一組器械與植入物該怎麼拆、怎麼洗、怎麼滅菌的官方說明。消毒供應中心照它做，不照習慣做。
plain.en: The maker's official document on how each set is dismantled, cleaned and sterilised. The CSSD follows it, not habit.

plain.zh: 裝著耐熱孢子的小瓶，和器械一起滅菌，再放進培養箱。孢子長不出來，才證明這一鍋真的殺得死。
plain.en: A small vial of heat-resistant spores that goes through the cycle with the instruments and then into an incubator. Only when the spores fail to grow is the load proven lethal.

plain.zh: 包外與包內的變色條。變色只代表「經過了滅菌條件」，不等於無菌。
plain.en: The colour-change strips outside and inside a pack. A change means the pack met the cycle's conditions; it does not by itself mean sterile.

plain.zh: 滅菌出鍋後包布或內部還有水珠或濕痕。濕的包不是無菌的包，整包重新處理。
plain.en: A pack that comes out of the steriliser with water or damp marks on or inside it. A wet pack is not a sterile pack; it is reprocessed from the start.

plain.zh: 以前叫「快速滅菌」。只給緊急又沒有替代品的情況，植入物不可以。
plain.en: What used to be called 'flash' sterilisation. Reserved for emergencies with no alternative, and never for implants.

plain.zh: 每一支鋼板與螺釘的批號貼進病歷，也留在消毒供應中心的紀錄。出了問題，能往回找到每一個環節。
plain.en: The lot number of every plate and screw goes into the patient's notes and into the CSSD record. If anything goes wrong, every step can be traced back.

plain.zh: 手術傷口或深部的感染。預防是一整個束包：抗生素時機、皮膚準備、保溫、血糖、無菌器械、人員流動。
plain.en: An infection of the wound or the deeper layers after an operation. Prevention is a whole bundle: antibiotic timing, skin preparation, warmth, glucose, sterile instruments, theatre traffic.

plain.zh: 接觸病人前、無菌操作前、體液暴露後、接觸病人後、接觸病人周遭環境後。
plain.en: Before touching a patient, before a clean procedure, after body-fluid exposure, after touching a patient, after touching the patient's surroundings.

plain.zh: 含植入物的鍋次先放在隔離架，等生物指示劑培養結果出來才放行。等不及時要有醫師簽名、督導同意，並留下紀錄。
plain.en: A load containing implants waits on a quarantine shelf until the biological indicator has been read. Releasing it earlier needs a doctor's signature, the supervisor's agreement and a written record.

plain.zh: 骨頭本身的感染。開放性骨折或植入物感染之後最怕的結果，治療是手術清創加長期抗生素。
plain.en: Infection of the bone itself: the outcome most feared after an open fracture or an infected implant. Treated with surgical debridement and a long course of antibiotics.

text.zh: 器械打開關節、拆到最小單位、不要疊著放。每一輪結束小龐都去看濾網：濾網會告訴他誰沒做使用點預處理。
text.en: Instruments go in opened, dismantled, never stacked. After every cycle Pang checks the filter: it tells him who skipped the point-of-use pre-treatment.

text.zh: 每天第一鍋先做空鍋測試。裝載不能太滿，包與包之間要留蒸氣的路，出鍋先冷卻再碰。
text.en: The first cycle of the day is an empty-chamber test. Never overload; leave the steam a path between packs; let the load cool before anyone touches it.

text.zh: 一支跟著器械進鍋，一支沒進鍋當對照。對照長、鍋裡那支不長，這一鍋才算過關。
text.en: One vial goes through the cycle, one stays out as a control. The control grows, the processed one does not: only then has the load passed.

text.zh: 掃描每一個包的條碼：誰洗、誰包、哪一鍋、哪一個病人。十年後還找得到。
text.en: Scans every pack's barcode: who washed it, who packed it, which cycle, which patient. Still traceable ten years from now.

text.zh: 玉梅姐的眼睛。檢查關節縫、螺紋、管腔與刀口：生物負荷、鏽、裂痕、缺角。
text.en: Yu-mei's eyes. It checks hinges, threads, lumens and cutting edges for bioburden, rust, cracks and chips.

text.zh: 廠商的清單上有一支螺釘今天數不到。玉梅姐說：少一支就是少一支，不是「大概夠」。
text.en: One screw on the company's list could not be found today. Yu-mei's verdict: one missing is one missing, not 'probably enough'.

text.zh: 阿鴻留下的示範用鋼板，不是植入物。明天給張小姐看「身體裡的那一片長這樣」。
text.en: The demonstration plate Hung left behind, not an implant. Tomorrow it shows Ms Chang what the piece inside her will look like.

name.zh: 單向流程與看不見的東西

text.zh: 消毒供應中心的每一道門都只往乾淨的方向開。清洗不夠乾淨的器械，滅菌只是把污垢烤熟。先把看得見的髒洗掉，才有資格談看不見的菌；而看不見的那一段，只能靠指示劑與紀錄來證明。
text.en: Every door in the CSSD opens only towards clean. Sterilising a badly washed instrument merely bakes the soil on. Remove the dirt you can see before you talk about the microbes you cannot; and the invisible part can only be proven by indicators and records.

text.zh: 提前到院、附製造商說明書與清點單、全程重新處理、含植入物的鍋次等生物指示劑結果、每一支植入物都追溯。沒有「上一家剛消毒過」這回事。遲到的托盤不是緊急狀況，是排程問題。
text.en: Arrive early, come with the manufacturer's instructions and a count sheet, be fully reprocessed, wait for the biological indicator if implants are in the load, and have every implant traced. 'The last hospital only just sterilised it' does not exist. A late tray is a scheduling problem, not an emergency.

text.zh: 感染不是一個原因造成的。抗生素時機、剪毛不剃毛、皮膚準備、保溫、血糖、無菌器械、傷口照護、手術室的門開了幾次、手部衛生。少做一項，其他幾項的功勞就打折。
text.en: No infection has a single cause. Antibiotic timing, clipping not shaving, skin preparation, warmth, glucose, sterile instruments, wound care, how often the theatre door opened, hand hygiene. Skip one item and the rest count for less.

note.en: Handover: the loaner tray has not arrived

lines.zh: 骨科的？歡迎來到醫院最安靜、最要緊的地方。換鞋、穿防護、再進去。這裡的門只往一個方向開。
lines.en: Orthopaedics? Welcome to the quietest and most important place in the hospital. Shoes, protective wear, then in. The doors here open one way only.

lines.zh: 單向流程：污染區進去，無菌區出來，不回頭。
lines.en: One-way flow: in through dirty, out through sterile, never backwards.

lines.zh: 對。明天第一台的借用器械還沒到，你是植入物協調人？
lines.en: Right. Tomorrow's first case has loaner instruments that haven't arrived. You're the implant coordinator?

lines.zh: 對。張小姐，右橈骨遠端骨折，掌側鎖定鋼板。廠商說八點送到。
lines.en: Yes. Ms Chang, right distal radius, volar locking plate. The company says eight o'clock.

lines.zh: 「說」。我們等著看。先跟小龐學洗。
lines.en: 'Says.' We'll see. First, learn to wash with Pang.

guide.zh: 跟小龐排再處理的順序
guide.en: Put the reprocessing steps in order with Pang

lines.zh: 手術室的血乾在器械上超過一小時，我這裡就要多洗一輪。先排順序，再碰器械。
lines.en: Blood left to dry on an instrument for over an hour in theatre costs me an extra wash cycle. Order first, instruments second.

q.zh: 一支用過的器械，從手術室回到無菌庫房的正確順序？
q.en: A used instrument, from theatre back to the sterile store: what is the right order?

steps.zh: 使用點預處理：擦拭、保濕
清點、分類、拆到最小單位
清洗消毒機清洗與熱消毒
放大燈下檢查、組裝、包裝
滅菌，附化學與生物指示劑
steps.en: Sterilise with chemical and biological indicators
Cool, record, into the sterile store

post.zh: 第一步在手術室就開始了，不在我這裡。回去跟刷手護理師說：器械下台先擦、先噴保濕。
post.en: The first step starts in theatre, not here. Tell your scrub nurses: wipe and spray the instruments the moment they come off the table.

note.zh: 借用托盤到院，全程重新處理

guide.en: Receive the loaner tray at the hatch

lines.zh: 不好意思遲到，塞車。這組上一家醫院昨天剛消毒過，有證明，可以直接進無菌庫房嗎？明天才用。
lines.en: Sorry I'm late, traffic. The last hospital sterilised this set yesterday, here's the certificate. Can it go straight into the sterile store? It's not needed until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 借用器械到院一律當未滅菌。清點單和製造商說明書帶了嗎？
lines.en: Loaner instruments arriving here count as unsterile. Did you bring the count sheet and the manufacturer's instructions for use?

lines.zh: 清點單有。說明書……在雲端，我傳連結。
lines.en: Count sheet, yes. The instructions... are in the cloud. I'll send a link.

lines.zh: 連結進不了污染區。印出來。阿鴻，這是第幾次了？
lines.en: A link can't come through the dirty-side door. Print it. Hung, how many times is this now?

lines.zh: ……第三次。
lines.en: ...the third.

q.zh: 借用托盤附上一家醫院的滅菌證明，明天才用。怎麼處理？
q.en: The loaner tray comes with another hospital's sterilisation certificate and is needed tomorrow. What do you do?

options.zh: 依說明書全程重新處理，等指示劑結果
options.en: Full reprocessing per the instructions; wait for the indicator

why.zh: 對。別人的滅菌紀錄不是你的。運送過程、包裝完整性，你一樣都沒看到。
why.en: Right. Someone else's sterilisation record is not yours. You saw neither the transport nor the state of the packaging.

options.zh: 證明在，直接進無菌庫房
options.en: The certificate is here; straight to the sterile store

why.zh: 看不見的才最要緊。運送中一個破角，整張證明就不算數。
why.en: What you can't see matters most. One torn corner in transit and that certificate is worth nothing.

options.zh: 先放著，明早在刀房立即使用滅菌
options.en: Leave it; flash it in theatre tomorrow morning

why.zh: 立即使用滅菌不給植入物、不給排好的手術。上個月那個感染案子就是這樣開頭的。
why.en: Immediate-use steam sterilisation is not for implants and not for a scheduled case. Last month's infection started exactly like this.

guide.zh: 把托盤送進清洗消毒機
guide.en: Load the tray into the washer-disinfector

lines.zh: 鋼板一片一片拿出來，螺釘盒打開，鑽頭導套拆開。疊著放的器械，水碰不到的地方就是沒洗。
lines.en: Plates out one by one, screw caddies open, drill guides apart. Anywhere the water can't reach on a stacked instrument is simply unwashed.

lines.zh: 動力工具的手機不能泡水，照製造商說明書擦洗。
lines.en: The power handpiece can't be immersed; it's wiped down according to the manufacturer's instructions for use.

lines.zh: 對。說明書在你手上，照著做，不照我的習慣做。
lines.en: Right. The instructions are in your hand. Follow them, not my habits.

q.zh: 點一下清洗消毒機，把拆開的借用托盤放進去
q.en: Tap the washer-disinfector and load the dismantled loaner tray

lines.zh: 鑽頭導套和吸引管有管腔，進機器前先手工刷：合適的刷子、水面下刷、沖到看不見東西。
lines.en: Drill guides and suction tips have lumens: brushed by hand before the machine, with the right brush, under the water line, rinsed until nothing comes out.

lines.zh: 刷子的尺寸要對。太小刷不到，太大進不去。
lines.en: The brush has to be the right size. Too small misses the wall; too big won't go in.

lines.zh: 刷完、脫手套、手部衛生，再去包裝區。手部衛生五時機在這裡也算數。
lines.en: Brushes done, gloves off, hand hygiene, then packing. The five moments for hand hygiene apply in here too.

note.zh: 放大燈下：一支螺釘不見了
note.en: Under the magnifier: one screw missing

guide.zh: 跟玉梅姐檢查借用器械
guide.en: Inspect the loaner set with Yu-mei

lines.zh: 洗好的借用托盤。放大燈下一支一支看：螺紋、關節、刀口、管腔，找生物負荷、鏽、裂痕。
lines.en: The washed loaner tray. Under the magnifier one at a time: threads, hinges, edges, lumens. We look for bioburden, rust and cracks.

lines.zh: 這支螺釘頭有一點黑的……
lines.en: This screw head has a dark fleck...

lines.zh: 鏽。退回廠商，不進包。現在數螺釘盒。
lines.en: Rust. Back to the company, not into the pack. Now count the caddy.

lines.zh: 清單寫的數目，少一支。
lines.en: Against the sheet: one short.

lines.zh: 少一支就是少一支，不是「大概夠」。打電話。
lines.en: One missing is one missing, not 'probably enough'. Make the call.

guide.zh: 看張小姐的片子核對托盤
guide.en: Check the tray against Ms Chang's film

lines.zh: 我把張小姐的片子叫出來，確認明天要的鋼板長度與螺釘範圍都在托盤裡。
lines.en: I'll bring up Ms Chang's film and confirm the plate length and screw range we need are in the tray.

lines.zh: 片子我看不懂，托盤我懂。你說要什麼，我找。
lines.en: I can't read films, but I know trays. Tell me what you need and I'll find it.

question.zh: 橈骨遠端骨折復位後位置跑掉，決定用掌側鎖定鋼板。看片子時要確認托盤裡有什麼？
question.en: A distal radius fracture has slipped after reduction and a volar locking plate is planned. Looking at the film, what must the tray contain?

answer.zh: 骨折的型態與粉碎程度決定鋼板的長度與形狀；遠端骨塊的大小決定遠端排螺釘的角度與長度範圍；關節面有沒有台階決定要不要加關節內的輔助固定；和對側或受傷當時的片子比較尺骨變異與長度。所以托盤要有合適的鋼板長度、完整的螺釘長度範圍、鑽頭導套與測深尺。
answer.en: The fracture pattern and comminution decide plate length and shape; the size of the distal fragment decides the angle and length range of the distal screw row; a step in the joint surface decides whether extra intra-articular fixation is needed; ulnar variance and length are compared with the other side or the injury film. So the tray must hold the right plate lengths, the full screw-length range, the drill guides and the depth gauge.

post.zh: 少的那一支，剛好在最常用的長度。
post.en: The missing one is exactly the most-used length.

post.zh: 那就是不能少的那一支。
post.en: Then it's the one that can't be missing.

sub.zh: 「托盤好了沒？張小姐可能提前到今天下午。」
sub.en: 'Is the tray ready? Ms Chang may be brought forward to this afternoon.'

lines.zh: 托盤好了沒？排程有空檔，張小姐可能提前到今天下午五點。
lines.en: Is the tray ready? There's a gap on the list; Ms Chang could come forward to five this afternoon.

lines.zh: 托盤在包裝區，少一支螺釘，廠商補送中。包好進鍋後含植入物，要等生物指示劑結果。今天下午來不及。
lines.en: The tray is in packing, one screw short, the company is sending it. Once it's packed and run, it has implants in the load, so we wait for the biological indicator. This afternoon can't be done.

lines.zh: 指示劑要等多久？
lines.en: How long does the indicator take?

lines.zh: 依培養箱的規範時間，今晚前有結果。她是閉合性骨折、夾板中、不痛。明天八點不會害到她，今天趕才會。
lines.en: The incubator's standard time; we'll have it tonight. She has a closed fracture, splinted, comfortable. Eight tomorrow doesn't harm her; rushing today might.

lines.zh: ……好，我去改刀表。你學會在電話裡說「不」了。
lines.en: ...fine, I'll change the list. You've learned to say 'no' on the phone.

note.zh: 上個月的深部感染：時間軸上的那一包
note.en: Last month's deep infection: the pack on the timeline

guide.zh: 和林感管師看感染案例
guide.en: Review the infection case with Nurse Lin

lines.zh: 上個月的陳先生：開放性脛骨骨折，清創加鋼板，三週後深部感染，現在在治療骨髓炎。我畫了時間軸。
lines.en: Mr Chen, last month: open tibial fracture, debridement and plating, deep infection three weeks later, now being treated for osteomyelitis. I drew the timeline.

lines.zh: 抗生素在急診就給了，清創也在時限內。
lines.en: Antibiotics were given in the ER and the debridement was within the window.

lines.zh: 都對。再看這裡：固定用的借用托盤，手術前四十分鐘到院，在手術室用立即使用滅菌處理。
lines.en: All correct. Now look here: the loaner tray for fixation arrived forty minutes before surgery and was put through immediate-use steam sterilisation in theatre.

lines.zh: 不是說那一包一定是原因。是說那一包是整個束包裡斷掉的一環。
lines.en: Nobody says that pack was definitely the cause. It was the broken link in the bundle.

lines.zh: 手術部位感染從來不是一個原因。束包有哪些，你數。
lines.en: A surgical site infection never has one cause. Count the bundle for me.

lines.zh: 抗生素時機、剪毛不剃毛、皮膚準備、保溫、血糖、無菌器械、手術室人員流動、傷口照護。
lines.en: Antibiotic timing, clipping not shaving, skin preparation, warmth, glucose, sterile instruments, theatre traffic, wound care.

lines.zh: 還有一項，你每天做幾十次。
lines.en: And one more, which you do dozens of times a day.

lines.zh: 手部衛生五時機。
lines.en: The five moments for hand hygiene.

lines.zh: 對。開放性骨折的抗生素是第一環，你再複習一次。
lines.en: Right. Antibiotics for an open fracture are the first link; go over it once more.

post.zh: 陳先生的事會寫成教案。今天你手上這個托盤，就是教案的結尾。
post.en: Mr Chen's case will become a teaching file. The tray in your hands today is how that file ends.

note.zh: 借用托盤進鍋；一包濕的退回
note.en: Loaner tray loaded; one wet pack rejected

lines.zh: 螺釘補到了，玉梅姐包好了。進鍋之前，說這一鍋要放什麼。
lines.en: The screw has arrived and Yu-mei has packed it. Before it goes in, tell me what goes into this load.

lines.zh: 包外與包內化學指示劑；生物指示劑一支跟著含植入物的鍋次，另一支留在外面當對照。鍋次號碼掃進追溯系統。
lines.en: A chemical indicator outside and inside the pack; one biological indicator through the cycle with the implant load, one kept out as the control. Cycle number scanned into the tracking system.

lines.zh: 裝載呢？
lines.en: And the loading?

lines.zh: 不塞滿，包與包之間留蒸氣的路，重的在下面，盆口朝下。
lines.en: Not full; a path for the steam between packs; heavy sets low; basins facing down.

guide.en: Practise drilling with the demo set

lines.zh: 這是示範組，不是植入物，附鋸骨模型。督導說借托盤的人一定要會用。
lines.en: This is the demo set, not implants, with a saw-bone. The supervisor says whoever borrows a tray has to know how to use it.

lines.zh: 對。借來的器械，在刀房第一次打開才學，對病人不公平。
lines.en: Right. Learning a borrowed set the first time it's opened in theatre is unfair to the patient.

lines.zh: 鑽頭垂直骨面、穿過兩層皮質、測深尺量長度。
lines.en: Drill perpendicular to the bone, through both cortices, measure with the depth gauge.

post.zh: 你比上一位住院醫師穩。
上一位現在是主治了，別讓他聽見。樣品留下，明天給病人看。
post.en: The last one is an attending now; don't let him hear you. Leave the sample; the patient can see it tomorrow.

lines.zh: 前一鍋出來了。玉梅姐拿起一包骨科基本組，包布角上有一片深色。
lines.en: The previous load comes out. Yu-mei lifts a basic orthopaedic set; one corner of the wrap is dark.

lines.zh: 濕包。
lines.en: A wet pack.

q.zh: 出鍋的器械包包布有濕痕，刀房一小時後要用。怎麼辦？
q.en: A pack comes out with a damp wrap and theatre wants it in an hour. What now?

options.zh: 整包重包重滅菌，通知刀房用備用組
options.en: Repack and resterilise; tell theatre to use the spare set

why.zh: 濕的包不是無菌的包。水是微生物走進去的橋。
why.en: A wet pack is not a sterile pack. Water is the bridge microbes walk across.

options.zh: 放著讓它乾，乾了就能用
options.en: Leave it to dry; once dry it's fine

why.zh: 外面乾了不代表裡面乾，而且濕著的那段時間已經不算無菌。
why.en: Dry outside does not mean dry inside, and the time it spent wet already broke sterility.

options.zh: 用毛巾或烘箱把它弄乾
options.en: Towel it or warm it dry

why.zh: 弄乾只是把問題藏起來，還可能把布纖維留在器械上。
why.en: Drying hides the problem and may leave fibres on the instruments.

post.zh: 裝載太滿、冷卻不夠、或蒸氣品質。查這三個。
post.en: Overloading, not enough cooling, or steam quality. Check those three.

post.zh: 查完寫下來。看不見的，才最要緊。
post.en: Check and write it down. What you can't see matters most.

note.zh: 托盤進隔離架；張小姐睡得著了
note.en: Tray on the quarantine shelf; Ms Chang can sleep

guide.en: Put the tray on the quarantine shelf

lines.zh: 借用托盤出鍋，化學指示劑都變色了。進無菌庫房的隔離架，貼「待生物指示劑結果」。這叫隔離放行。
lines.en: The loaner tray is out and every chemical indicator has changed. It goes on the quarantine shelf in the sterile store, labelled 'awaiting biological indicator'. That is quarantine release.

lines.zh: 貼紙貼好，誰都不能拿。連學長打電話來也不能。
lines.en: Label on, nobody touches it. Not even if your chief rings.

lines.zh: 追溯系統：鍋次、指示劑編號、病人張小姐。
lines.en: Tracking system: cycle number, indicator number, patient Ms Chang.

lines.zh: 手機震了一下。阿強學長：「明早八點確定。對不起我下午催你。」
lines.en: The phone buzzes. Dr Chiang: 'Eight tomorrow confirmed. Sorry I pushed you this afternoon.'

guide.zh: 游督導提起早上那張證明
guide.en: Supervisor Yu brings up that certificate

lines.zh: 早上你本來想憑那張證明，直接把它放進這個架子。
lines.en: This morning you were ready to put it on this shelf on the strength of that certificate.

lines.zh: 對。
lines.en: I was.

lines.zh: 現在你知道它中間經過了幾雙手、幾台機器、幾張紀錄。那張紙替代不了任何一項。
lines.en: Now you know how many hands, machines and records it passed through in between. That piece of paper replaces none of them.

guide.zh: 游督導提起「明早快速滅菌」
guide.en: Supervisor Yu brings up 'flash it tomorrow'

lines.zh: 早上你想明早在刀房做立即使用滅菌。
lines.en: This morning you wanted immediate-use steam sterilisation in theatre tomorrow.

lines.zh: 對。陳先生的時間軸上就是那一包。
lines.en: I did. That's the pack on Mr Chen's timeline.

lines.zh: 立即使用滅菌是給緊急的，不是給遲到的。
lines.en: Immediate-use sterilisation is for emergencies, not for lateness.

sub.zh: 7 床張小姐想問「借用器械」是什麼意思
sub.en: Bed 7, Ms Chang, wants to know what 'loaner instruments' means

lines.zh: 醫師，張小姐在網路上查「借用器械」，查到心慌。我把電話拿給她。
lines.en: Doctor, Ms Chang googled 'loaner instruments' and worked herself into a state. I'm handing her the phone.

lines.zh: 醫師，借來的……是用過的嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, borrowed... does that mean used?

lines.zh: 器械是廠商的，每家醫院用完都會還；但一進我們醫院就從清洗開始全部重做，和自己的器械一樣。
lines.en: The instruments belong to the company and every hospital returns them, but the moment they arrive here they are fully reprocessed from the wash up, exactly like our own.

lines.zh: 鋼板和螺釘是全新的，一支一支有批號，會貼進你的病歷。這叫植入物追溯。
lines.en: The plate and screws are brand new, each with a lot number that goes into your notes. That is implant traceability.

lines.zh: 十年後也找得到？
lines.en: Even ten years from now?

lines.zh: 十年後也找得到它從哪裡來、誰洗的、哪一鍋。
lines.en: Ten years from now we can still find where it came from, who washed it and which cycle.

lines.zh: ……那我可以睡了。
lines.en: ...then I can sleep.

lines.zh: 今天三件事。你在電話裡說了「不」。你把濕包退了回去。
lines.en: Three things today. You said 'no' on the phone. You sent the wet pack back.

lines.zh: 還有，你跟病人解釋了借用器械，用的是今天你自己走過的每一步。
lines.en: And you explained loaner instruments to a patient using every step you walked through yourself today.

lines.zh: 指示劑今晚讀。
lines.en: The indicator reads tonight.

lines.zh: 我猜你會回來看。去吃飯。
lines.en: I suspect you'll come back to watch it. Go and eat.

note.zh: 病房的發燒先看人；指示劑沒長
note.en: The ward fever: patient first; the indicator did not grow

sub.zh: 12 床今天下午的踝關節鋼板，術後第一晚發燒
sub.en: Bed 12, this afternoon's ankle plate, febrile on the first night

lines.zh: 醫師，12 床下午的踝關節鋼板，晚上發燒，我量了兩次。家屬問是不是器械不乾淨。
lines.en: Doctor, bed 12, the ankle plate from this afternoon, is febrile tonight; I took it twice. The family are asking whether the instruments were dirty.

lines.zh: 先看人，不先看托盤。我過去。
lines.en: Patient first, tray second. I'm coming up.

options.zh: 床邊評估傷口、肺、尿、點滴，依規範培養，通知主治
options.en: Assess wound, chest, urine and lines at the bedside; cultures per protocol; inform the attending

why.zh: 對。術後第一晚的發燒最常是肺部擴張不全與手術反應；手術部位感染通常幾天後才出現。評估、培養，再談原因。
why.en: Right. A first-night fever is most often atelectasis or the body's response to surgery; a surgical site infection usually declares itself days later. Assess, culture, then talk about causes.

options.zh: 直接給廣效抗生素，器械可能有問題
options.en: Start broad antibiotics; the instruments may have been the problem

why.zh: 沒有評估就給抗生素，蓋掉所有線索，而且沒有任何證據指向器械。
why.en: Antibiotics without an assessment bury every clue, and nothing points at the instruments.

options.zh: 電話裡說第一晚發燒正常，明早再看
options.en: Say first-night fevers are normal; review in the morning

why.zh: 「通常正常」不等於「這一位正常」。去看。
why.en: 'Usually normal' is not the same as 'normal in this patient'. Go and look.

post.zh: 看過了：傷口乾、肺底呼吸音弱，深呼吸幾次就好一些。擴胸、調整止痛、依醫囑觀察。
post.en: Seen: wound dry, breath sounds quiet at the bases, better after a few deep breaths. Chest expansion, analgesia adjusted, observe per orders.

post.zh: 我跟他們說了：今天用的每一包器械，我都知道它經過哪些步驟。這句話我今天才有資格說。
post.en: I told them: every pack used today, I know exactly what steps it went through. Until today I couldn't have said that.

guide.en: Back to the incubator for the result

lines.zh: 督導說你一定會回來。來，對照那支變色了，表示孢子活著；鍋裡那支沒變。
lines.en: The supervisor said you'd be back. Look: the control has changed colour, so the spores were alive; the one from the load has not.

lines.zh: 對照長、鍋裡不長。生物指示劑過關。
lines.en: Control grows, load does not. The biological indicator passes.

lines.zh: 掃進系統、撕掉隔離貼紙。明早七點玉梅姐會親手交到刀房。
lines.en: Scan it, peel off the quarantine label. At seven Yu-mei hands it to theatre herself.

lines.zh: 植入物追溯的最後一格填上了。
lines.en: The last box of the implant traceability record is filled in.

guide.en: One last look at the tray

lines.zh: 無菌庫房的燈很白。借用托盤躺在架上，貼紙寫著：張小姐・明日 08:00・已放行。
lines.en: The sterile store's light is very white. The loaner tray lies on its shelf; the label reads: Ms Chang, tomorrow 08:00, released.

lines.zh: 一個借來的托盤、一包濕的、一支沒長的指示劑。看得見的髒洗掉了，看不見的也有紀錄。
lines.en: A loaner tray, a wet pack and an indicator that did not grow. The dirt you could see is gone; the part you couldn't see is on record.

lines.zh: 手機亮了。游督導：「明天刀房開包時，記得看包內的化學指示劑。然後去睡。」
lines.en: The phone lights up. Supervisor Yu: 'When they open the pack in theatre tomorrow, check the internal chemical indicator. Then sleep.'

sub.en: What you can't see matters most
